description: WHO's Surveillance System for Attacks on Health Care recorded 735 attacks on health care in Gaza from 7 October 2023 to 11 June 2025, killing 917 people, injuring 1,411, affecting 125 health facilities and damaging 34 hospitals.
energy_note: Seven hundred and thirty-five attacks on health care.

description: WHO has documented at least 1,580 health workers killed; the UN Human Rights Office reported at least 1,581, including doctors and nurses who died with their families in residential buildings and tents, and expressed grave concern about a pattern of intentional killings. The Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics reported at least 1,701 health sector workers killed between October 2023 and October 2025.
energy_note: Sixteen hundred doctors, nurses and paramedics.

aspect: The comparison that gives it scale
description: By mid-2024, health worker deaths in Gaza had already exceeded the combined total documented across all other global conflicts in 2022.
energy_note: More than every other war on earth, combined, in a year.

description: B'Tselem reported only 17 of Gaza's 36 hospitals functioning and 2.5% of Gaza's medical personnel killed. WHO noted more than half of hospitals closed, with those still operating able to provide only very limited emergency, life-saving surgery and intensive care.
energy_note: Seventeen hospitals, for two million people.

description: UN experts described the destruction of Gaza's healthcare system as 'medicide', stating that health and care workers have been 'continuously targeted, detained, tortured' and are now being starved along with the rest of the population.
energy_note: A word invented because the existing ones were too small.

aspect: Every row in the MED category depends on this one
description: The referral system, the permit queue and the specialty lottery in MED-001 to MED-004 all presuppose hospitals to be referred to. This issue is why those processes increasingly refer to nothing.
energy_note: A referral system pointing at rubble.

aspect: And it lands on women twice
description: Nursing and midwifery are majority-female professions here, so the workforce being killed and detained is disproportionately female - and the patients most dependent on the destroyed obstetric capacity are women. Both ends of WOM-006 run through this issue.
energy_note: The midwives are killed, and then there are no midwives.
